scientific_integrity: The p=1 and p=2 specialized formulas are known prior cases, not independently novel. No independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only three-point full windows on finite unweighted real open paths. Nonquadratic sharpness is by limiting pairs; not an assertion of finite-pair attainment. Equivalence in unindexed literature cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp path-variation sensitivity of sliding triple pairwise \(\ell_p\) dispersion
